game_concept: A speed quiz set in Sand Dunes – Mirage Road, a road of shimmering mirages: the scarab scholar must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Logic Detective: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug.
theme: Sand Dunes – Mirage Road: a road of shimmering mirages
core_gameplay_loop: In Mirage Road, repeat each round: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug. Each round, a new scarab charms challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the clues value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 210 points of scarab charms by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 210, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Logic Detective
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Logic Detective' (Week 9 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Mirage Road'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clues changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against desert bandits in Mirage Road.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 210 within 63 seconds.
